camel_example: aliyun polardb DeleteMaskingRules --region cn-hangzhou --InterfaceVersion v1 --RuleNameList testrule --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000000'
description_en: Deletes the specified data masking rules
kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-masking-rules --rule-name-list testrule --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --interface-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMaskingRules

parameters.help_en:
The names of the data masking rules to delete. To delete multiple rules in a batch, separate the names with commas (,).

> For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的脱敏规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html接口查看目标集群下所有脱敏规则的详情，包括规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

> For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of rule to delete. Valid values:

v1: deletes data masking rules.
v2: deletes data encryption rules
parameters.help_zh:
删除脱敏加密规则。取值范围如下：

v1：删除脱敏规则。
v2：删除加密规则
parameters.name: interface_version
